watcher_path.description: Path to watch (required in active watcher blocks)

watcher_level.description: Optional recursion level for directory watching

watcher_file_pattern_list.description: Space-separated list of file name patterns to match (optional)

watcher_event_list.description: Space-separated list of events to watch for (e.g., create, modify, delete)

watcher_command_line.description: Command to execute when an event occurs

watcher_user.description: User to run the command as (optional)

watcher_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for command execution (optional)

example_watcher_path.description: Path used in the commented example

example_watcher_command.description: Command used in the commented example
